note: Bighorn NF (Tongue Ranger District) campground beside the historic CCC-built Big Goose Ranger Station, 0.1 mile off Red Grade/Big Goose Road (FSR 26), about 18 miles south of Big Horn via WY-335. No horses. --Claude

No rec.gov listing for this campground (rec.gov 'Ranger Creek Recreation Area' 231834 is a Shell Canyon group site 22 km away). Site count, lengths unstated.
